detail.longDescription: FURSY is a type-safe HTTP router for Go 1.27+ with zero-alloc routing, RFC 9457 errors, and Google AIP-136 support. An independent audit found CORS bypass, phantom docs, and more — here's what we fixed. # go # opensource # webdev # security # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community Go 1.27 HTTP Router with Generic Methods and Zero-Alloc Routing: FURSY — What an Independent Audit Found at 94% Coverage
